notes.title: Official Release Date
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that Thing-in-Itself will be officially released on Steam, January 5th 2017! Thank you for all of your support these past months-- we are so excited to finally share our finished work with you!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27212213/69dc483486169fbfca3b90c8466391834d932287.png
